get.summary: List inbox conversations with filtering, search and pagination.

parameters.name: assignedToId
parameters.description: Filter by the assigned operator user id.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search over the contact name/phone and message bodies.

get.summary: Get a single conversation with its contact, messages and bot drafts.

patch.summary: Triage a conversation: pin/unpin, set tags, assign/unassign an operator.

post.summary: Send a free-form operator reply to the customer via WhatsApp.
Close a conversation with a disposition, triggering resolution capture.

get.summary: List bot escalation drafts (defaults to PENDING), newest first.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filter by draft state (defaults to PENDING).

post.summary: Approve a pending draft: send it to the customer as-is and record the reply.
Edit a pending draft: send the revised body to the customer and record it.
Reject a pending draft: discard it so the operator replies manually.

get.summary: Aggregate decision stats over a rolling window (rates, latencies, daily series).

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Window in days for the aggregate stats and the daily series.

get.summary: Paginated, filterable audit list of chatbot decisions (newest first).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO date-time lower bound (inclusive) on created_at.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO date-time upper bound (inclusive) on created_at.

get.summary: List knowledge documents with optional category/status/search filters.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by category, e.g. Logistics / Billing / Resolved tickets.

post.summary: Create a document from raw markdown; chunks + embeds when autoIngest.

get.summary: Fetch a single document with its chunk count.

patch.summary: Update document fields; re-ingests when contentMd changes.

delete.summary: Delete a document; chunks and citations cascade.

get.summary: Per-document analytics: embeddings, citations/day, grounded %, recent uses.

post.summary: Create a document by uploading a .md/.markdown file (field "file").
Mark a document LIVE (requires at least one chunk).
Return a document to DRAFT, removing it from retrieval.
Re-chunk and re-embed a document from its current content.
Semantic search over LIVE chunks (admin preview of bot retrieval).
Build a capture preview (proposed title/content + LIVE duplicates) for a conversation.

get.summary: List resolution captures with status/disposition/closed-at filters.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO date-time lower bound (inclusive) on closed_at.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO date-time upper bound (inclusive) on closed_at.

get.summary: Get a single capture with its document and originating conversation.

post.summary: Promote a captured DRAFT doc to LIVE (re-runs dedup unless forced).
Discard a capture: archive its document and mark the capture discarded.

get.summary: List all chatbot settings, coerced to their real JS types.

patch.summary: Update one or more chatbot settings; returns the refreshed set.

info.title: WhatsApp Blasting API
info.description: REST API for the blasting platform and the AI chatbot inbox + admin surface.

pinned.description: Pin/unpin the conversation in the inbox.

assignedToId.description: Assign to an operator (null to unassign).

body.description: Free-form operator reply, sent to the customer via WhatsApp.

disposition.description: IMPORT_LIVE publishes the resolution to the KB; SAVE_DRAFT stores it as a draft for review; SKIP captures nothing.

resolutionNotes.description: Internal notes about how the ticket was resolved.

editedAnswer.description: Cleaned-up answer used as the authoritative KB content (overrides the literal operator reply).

forcedDespiteDuplicate.description: Capture even if a near-duplicate KB doc already exists.

body.description: Edited reply body; sent to the customer and recorded as the operator reply.

reason.description: Why the draft was rejected (audit only).

category.description: Category, e.g. Logistics / Billing / General / Resolved tickets.

contentMd.description: New markdown body; triggers re-ingest when changed.

query.description: Query text to embed and match against LIVE chunks.

minScore.description: Minimum cosine similarity for a chunk to count.

category.description: Restrict the search to one category.

conversationId.description: Conversation to build a capture preview for (must have an operator reply on record).

forcedDespiteDuplicate.description: Promote even if a near-duplicate LIVE doc already exists.

reason.description: Why the captured doc was discarded (audit only).

disable_auto_reply.description: When true, the bot drafts but never auto-sends.

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum draft confidence required to auto-send.

business_name.description: Business display name used in bot replies.

business_hours_end.description: End of business hours (HH:MM; '24:00' = end of day).

escalation_phone.description: Phone number (E.164) used for human escalation.

retrieval_top_k.description: Number of knowledge chunks to retrieve per query.

retrieval_min_score.description: Minimum cosine similarity for a retrieved chunk.
